code:
opencode stats                        # everything, all time, all projects
opencode stats --days 1 --project ""  # today, in the current project only
opencode stats --days 7 --models      # the last week, broken down by model
description: Three opencode stats commands that total tokens and cost across sessions, scoped by day and project, or broken down by model.

steps.description: `opencode stats` prints token and cost totals for every session on your machine. Each line scopes it differently.
With no flags, the command totals everything, all time, across all projects.
`--days 1 --project ""` limits the totals to today, in the current project only.
`--days 7 --models` covers the last week and adds a per-model breakdown.

title: Token Totals Across Sessions
